description: Classifies local data sources by tier. Agents read this to know which data is authoritative vs supplementary vs future.

required.description: Must be present for the app to function. Missing files cause 404/500 errors.

sources.description: Oracle card text — canonical source for all card behavior. Used by /api/cards and all agents via cardContext.js.
sources.format: flat JSON array of card objects

sources.description: Official WotC rulings indexed by oracle_id. Used by /api/cards?rulingsFor and Arbiter.
sources.format: flat JSON array of ruling objects

validation.description: Improves Arbiter accuracy and grounds agent responses. Not required for basic function.

sources.description: 500 human-verified rules scenarios used as Arbiter grounding examples.
L00-L10 Comprehensive Rules verbatim codex. Arbiter uses this for CR citations.

future.description: Phase 3+ data sources. Present on disk but not wired into any runtime route yet.

sources.description: All printings with set/collector info. Needed for artwork, price, set-specific lookup.
sources.note: Not loaded anywhere. P3 work — build a printings index with lazy load.

sources.description: Every single printing with complete metadata including tokens, emblems, etc.
sources.note: Unlikely to be needed. Superset of default_cards. Only load specific fields if required.

sources.description: One card per unique illustration. For art browsing only — out of scope for this tool.
